changelog:
- Initial release of ntriq-x402-audio-intel-batch.  
- Batch audio transcription for up to 500 files in one call.
- Flat $9.00 USDC payment via x402 protocol.
- 100% local Whisper inference on Mac Mini.
- Simple API: submit audio file URLs and optionally force language.
- Returns transcriptions, auto-detects language, and provides duration per file.
summary: Batch audio transcription for up to 500 files. Flat $9.00 USDC via x402.
